title: Connectivity/error-handling guidance lives in guides/connectivity-errors.md
answers: Where are docs about handling data source connectivity errors in alert rules?
Where should I add guidance about no-data/error-handling or alert noise reduction?
body: General guidance for configuring alert rule behavior on execution errors/timeouts, choosing per-rule vs dedicated health alerts, and reducing redundant error notifications is consolidated in docs/sources/alerting/guides/connectivity-errors.md, organized by subsections with anchors (e.g. #build-a-dedicated-data-source-health-alert). It cross-references the no-data/error-handling config page and pending-period concept via `ref:configure-nodata-and-error-handling` and `ref:pending-period` shortcodes rather than hardcoded URLs.
applies: Grafana docs repo, alerting guides section.
